method.execution: Real CTest --tests-from-file, original commands/properties and independent process per selected registration; --output-junit records every result.
method.preflight: Before every round: restore binary/CTest metadata snapshots at identical paths and verify SHA; compare active CTest commands and properties; execute each selected EXE machine-readable discovery and verify every selected identity exactly once.
method.excluded_from_timer: Artifact restoration, discovery/DLL preflight and one initial warmup per cohort. Reverse BAAB extension adds no warmups.
method.timed_work: CTest execution only; no configure, compilation, source switching or build commands enter timed intervals.
method.snapshots: Only EXE/DLL/CTest metadata switched. Final test source/resources remain in place; the 22 historical script resources required by baseline were confirmed byte-identical to final.
method.runtime_failure_policy: Any failure, missing result, mismatch or skip invalidates a performance round; none occurred. No samples were discarded.
method.process_safety: Inherited Windows error mode suppresses modal loader/crash dialogs; a watchdog kills only its own launched process tree on abnormal termination.
method.scope_note: Selected optimized tasks, including real graphics/VM/physics adapters and moved unit work; not the entire integration or full repository suite.

task_group_duration_semantics: Median of summed JUnit testcase durations per round. Groups overlap, and parallel workers overlap in elapsed time; these values are not task wall times and must not be added to infer total wall time.
